Option Explicit

Sub TransformStatementDetails()
    '===================================================================================
    ' Macro: TransformStatementDetails
    ' Purpose: Transform data on "Statement Details" sheet
    ' Author: Generated by Copilot
    ' Date: 13 July 2026
    '===================================================================================
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim dateText As String
    Dim dayPart As String, monthPart As String, yearPart As String
    Dim convertedDate As Date
    Dim amountText As String
    Dim amountValue As Double
    Dim claimText As String
    Dim first6Chars As String
    
    ' Set reference to the worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Statement Details")
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Sheet 'Statement Details' not found!", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' Turn off screen updating for performance
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    ' Find the last row with data
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 6: Add column J with heading "Claim Number" BEFORE processing
    ' (Do this first before any row deletions)
    '===================================================================================
    ws.Cells(1, "J").Value = "Claim Number"
    ws.Cells(1, "J").Font.Bold = True
    
    ' Extract claim numbers from column I (first 6 chars if numeric)
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        claimText = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "I").Value))
        If Len(claimText) >= 6 Then
            first6Chars = Left(claimText, 6)
            ' Check if first 6 characters are numeric
            If IsNumeric(first6Chars) Then
                ws.Cells(i, "J").Value = CLng(first6Chars)
                ws.Cells(i, "J").NumberFormat = "0"
                ws.Cells(i, "J").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 7: Delete column H
    '===================================================================================
    ws.Columns("H").Delete
    
    ' Note: After deleting column H, former column I becomes H, former column J becomes I
    ' So Claim Number is now in column I
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 3: Delete all rows where column D is null or blank
    ' (Process from bottom to top to avoid skipping rows)
    '===================================================================================
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If IsEmpty(ws.Cells(i, "D").Value) Or Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "D").Value)) = "" Then
            ws.Rows(i).Delete
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Recalculate last row after deletions
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 1: Convert dates in column B from text (d/mm/yy or dd/mm/yy) to yyyy/mm/dd
    '===================================================================================
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        dateText = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "B").Value))
        
        If Len(dateText) > 0 And InStr(dateText, "/") > 0 Then
            ' Split the date parts
            Dim dateParts() As String
            dateParts = Split(dateText, "/")
            
            If UBound(dateParts) = 2 Then
                dayPart = Trim(dateParts(0))
                monthPart = Trim(dateParts(1))
                yearPart = Trim(dateParts(2))
                
                ' Add "20" prefix to year if it's 2 digits
                If Len(yearPart) = 2 Then
                    yearPart = "20" & yearPart
                End If
                
                ' Pad day and month with leading zeros if needed
                If Len(dayPart) = 1 Then dayPart = "0" & dayPart
                If Len(monthPart) = 1 Then monthPart = "0" & monthPart
                
                ' Create the date and format it
                On Error Resume Next
                convertedDate = DateSerial(CInt(yearPart), CInt(monthPart), CInt(dayPart))
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    ws.Cells(i, "B").Value = convertedDate
                    ws.Cells(i, "B").NumberFormat = "yyyy/mm/dd"
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 2: Convert numbers in column C to integers, no formatting, center aligned
    '===================================================================================
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If Len(Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "C").Value))) > 0 Then
            On Error Resume Next
            ws.Cells(i, "C").Value = CLng(Val(Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "C").Value))))
            ws.Cells(i, "C").NumberFormat = "0"
            ws.Cells(i, "C").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next i
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 4: Convert amounts in column F to number with 2 decimals, space as 1000 separator
    '===================================================================================
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        amountText = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "F").Value))
        If Len(amountText) > 0 Then
            ' Remove any existing spaces (thousand separators)
            amountText = Replace(amountText, " ", "")
            On Error Resume Next
            amountValue = CDbl(amountText)
            If Err.Number = 0 Then
                ws.Cells(i, "F").Value = amountValue
                ws.Cells(i, "F").NumberFormat = "# ##0.00"
            End If
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next i
    
    '===================================================================================
    ' Step 5: Remove trailing "-" from column G, convert to number with 2 decimals
    ' and space as 1000 separator
    '===================================================================================
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        amountText = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, "G").Value))
        If Len(amountText) > 0 Then
            ' Remove trailing "-"
            If Right(amountText, 1) = "-" Then
                amountText = Left(amountText, Len(amountText) - 1)
                ' This was a negative number, so make it negative
                amountText = Trim(amountText)
            End If
            ' Remove any existing spaces (thousand separators)
            amountText = Replace(amountText, " ", "")
            On Error Resume Next
            amountValue = CDbl(amountText)
            If Err.Number = 0 Then
                ws.Cells(i, "G").Value = amountValue
                ws.Cells(i, "G").NumberFormat = "# ##0.00"
            End If
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Auto-fit columns for better display
    ws.Columns("A:I").AutoFit
    
    ' Restore application settings
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "Data transformation completed successfully!" & vbCrLf & _
           "Rows processed: " & lastRow - 1, vbInformation
    
End Sub
